risks.description: High burn multiple (1.69) indicates inefficient capital use; net burn of $12K/month may deplete cash before break-even.
Competition from established players like ForecastPro and RetailEdge may limit market share acquisition.
Small team (4) may struggle to scale support and product development as customer base grows.

strengths: Positive revenue growth (8% MoM) indicates product-market fit
15-month runway provides time for iterative improvements
Subscription model ensures recurring revenue stream
weaknesses: High burn relative to revenue (revenue-to-expense ratio 0.4)
Limited brand recognition in target market
Gross margin unknown due to lack of cost data
opportunities: Niche market with low competition and high growth potential for specialized tools
Increasing adoption of SaaS among small businesses post-pandemic
Partnerships with POS providers could accelerate customer acquisition
threats: Economic downturn could reduce retailer spending on software
Large competitors may enter niche with bundled offerings
Customer churn if ROI is not clearly demonstrated

recommendations.title: Optimize Burn Rate
recommendations.description: Reduce monthly burn by 20% through optimized marketing spend and operational efficiencies to extend runway beyond 15 months.

recommendations.title: Enhance Revenue per Customer
recommendations.description: Focus on customer retention and upselling existing clients to increase MRR without proportional increase in acquisition costs.

recommendations.title: Refine Pricing Strategy
recommendations.description: Validate pricing model with pilot customers to ensure perceived value justifies subscription fees and improves gross margin.

recommendations.title: Strategic Hiring
recommendations.description: Hire 1-2 key hires (e.g., sales or engineering) only after achieving $15K MRR to maintain team agility and control burn.

executive_summary.overview: Inventory Pilot serves independent retailers with SaaS forecasting tools. It has $180K cash, $8K MRR, and 15 months runway. Growth is positive but burn remains high relative to revenue, requiring efficient scaling.
executive_summary.positioning: Position as affordable, intuitive alternative for small retailers lacking enterprise resources. Emphasize ease-of-use and rapid ROI over advanced AI features.
executive_summary.risks_headline: High burn multiple (1.69) and long CAC payback period threaten sustainability. Limited team size may hinder product development and customer support.
executive_summary.critical_callout: 15-month runway with 8% MRR growth suggests survival risk if acquisition costs exceed $200/customer.
executive_summary.success_callout: Achieving 15%+ MRR growth could extend runway and improve funding prospects, but requires disciplined execution.

market_analysis.projection: Total addressable market estimated at $500M annually. Current penetration is <1%. Growth potential is high if customer acquisition cost remains below $200.
market_analysis.analysis: SaaS inventory forecasting for independent retailers is niche but growing. Competition is moderate; opportunity exists for focused, low-cost solutions.
